label: Pose
description: Body postures and arrangements of limbs that fit an unspecified setting.
notes: Stationary body posture only, including head angle as part of posture. Gaze owns viewing direction; expression owns facial emotion. Excludes props, furniture, named places, clothing, and movement sequences. Seated and reclining poses require appropriate space but have no indoor or outdoor restriction.
